notes: Windows testing build: consistent outline icons; a sliding, pinnable sidebar; a redesigned NotzUp library with short local audio recording/import, playback, editable transcripts, summaries, action items, translation and branded exports; optional pinned local speech setup with integrity verification and an English meeting test. Save reusable profiles, specialist teams, custom templates and per-agent instructions/model/answer/sampling settings. Use @ in chat to combine agents, teams, profiles, templates, notes, memory and qualified models. Run settings are snapshotted and model quality gates remain enforced. Speech clips are limited to 1 minute 55 seconds; automatic speaker identification and full NotzUp account/mobile feature parity are not included. Connected processing is labeled. The existing installation method and demo key are unchanged, and updates reuse activation. Windows only; Mac feeds are unchanged.
